author: LHSummers
text: .@Krauthammer and I disagreed on almost everything political. But I so admired his clarity, his forceful logic, his courage, his adherence to principle and his always civil manner.  I will miss his writing and his friendship.

author: LHSummers
text: Julio gave me a great gift.  If I thought a subject was interesting or I wanted to understand it better, that was enough.  He would turn his mind to the issue.  He would help me articulate the impulse that I had and then note the good reasons it was unlikely to be shared.

author: LHSummers
text: One thing that stands out for me when I think about Julio was the generosity and capaciousness of his intellectual spirit.  There was no idea that he would not entertain, no hypothesis he would not consider, and no subject he would not address.

author: LHSummers

author: LHSummers
text: Saw @morningmoneyben on @WhiteHouseCEA Kevin Hassett’s victory lap. My response: No Keynesian economist, a category that include all who have advised Democrat administrations, would deny that a budget busting tax cut would be short run stimulative. A strong 2018 proves nothing.

author: LHSummers
text: The USG and it’s Puerto Rico oversight board are in grave danger of repeating Europe's errors in dealing with debtor countries.  Delusional optimism about structural reform leads to too much debt service, too much austerity and then politics that undermine the structural reforms.

author: LHSummers
text: The danger is that Puerto Rico's oversight board will countenance too much debt service and too much austerity because of rosy scenario economics and excessive faith in structural reform.

author: LHSummers
text: Puerto Rico's oversight board is far off in overestimating what it can afford to pay in debt service. Read my blog posting in @Wonkblog: https://t.co/87qhu8bGEg
